name: [daemind] 24 - Shopee: Ingestão de Pedidos, Escrow Líquido & Rastreamento

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO processed_events (source_system, event_id, webhook_topic)
VALUES (
  'Shopee',
  '{{$json.dedup_hash}}',
  'pedido_{{$json.status_operacional}}'
)
ON CONFLICT (source_system, event_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING event_id;

WITH ins_cli AS (
  INSERT INTO clientes (nome, email, whatsapp, origem_principal)
  VALUES (
    '{{$('Parser Shopee').item.json.cliente_nome}}',
    NULLIF('{{$('Parser Shopee').item.json.cliente_email}}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{$('Parser Shopee').item.json.cliente_whatsapp}}', ''),
    'Shopee'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE 
  SET whatsapp = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.whatsapp, clientes.whatsapp),
      nome = EXCLUDED.nome,
      updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO pedidos (numero_pedido, cliente_id, valor_total, status_operacional, data_criacao)
VALUES (
  {{$('Parser Shopee').item.json.numero_pedido}},
  (SELECT id FROM ins_cli UNION SELECT id FROM clientes WHERE email = '{{$('Parser Shopee').item.json.cliente_email}}' OR whatsapp = '{{$('Parser Shopee').item.json.cliente_whatsapp}}' LIMIT 1),
  {{$('Parser Shopee').item.json.valor_total}},
  '{{$('Parser Shopee').item.json.status_operacional}}',
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
ON CONFLICT (numero_pedido) DO UPDATE 
SET status_operacional = EXCLUDED.status_operacional,
    valor_total = EXCLUDED.valor_total,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RETURNING id, numero_pedido, cliente_id, valor_total, status_operacional;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO fila_mensageria (event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, whatsapp, payload, status, idempotency_key)
VALUES (
  'pedido_shopee',
  'pedidos',
  {{$json.id}},
  '{{$('Parser Shopee').item.json.cliente_whatsapp}}',
  '{"pedido": "{{$('Parser Shopee').item.json.order_sn}}", "status": "{{$json.status_operacional}}", "origem": "Shopee"}'::jsonb,
  'concluido',
  'shopee_ped_{{$('Parser Shopee').item.json.order_sn}}_{{$json.status_operacional}}'
)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
